controls.label: Source constraints
controls.description: Shape measurements mapped onto the nucleus. Solid gray marks stereo measurements, blue marks limb outlines, and the grid marks poorly constrained regions.
controls.title: Shape measurements and their coverage.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: The published nucleus shape, simplified for display. Gray is a model material; the grid marks regions with weaker shape constraints.
controls.title: Published nucleus shape; gray is a model material.

controls.label: EPOXI photographs
controls.description: EPOXI photographed Hartley 2 during its 2010 flyby. The smooth waist contrasts with the rough lobes. Original shadows remain; the gray grid marks gaps or poorly constrained shape.
controls.title: EPOXI photographed Hartley 2 during its 2010 flyby. The smooth waist contrasts with the rough lobes. Original shadows remain; the gray grid marks gaps or poorly constrained shape.

controls.label: Restored HRI photographs
controls.description: The mission team restored these HRI images to reduce optical blur. Some grain and ringing remain. Original shadows are preserved; the gray grid marks gaps or poorly constrained shape.
controls.title: The mission team restored these HRI images to reduce optical blur. Some grain and ringing remain. Original shadows are preserved; the gray grid marks gaps or poorly constrained shape.
